content.content: I remember installing Slackware in 1994 from a huge box of 24 floppies.  Back then it didn't really work out of the box, you hoped it would boot to be functional enough to log in and fix it the rest of the way.  I so admired Linus creating a UNIX OS regular people could install and tinker with, and have been a big fan watching it bloom into what it is now.  I have used it for many applications and things along the way, even putting it on embedded devices for products.  Linux has been a phenomenon which has smashed all barriers for anyone to have the latest technology to create and learn.  I'm convinced we would all be slaves of the industry if Linus had never created Linux.
